note: A single shaded back-in dirt site under conifers on Red Ridge Road, about 500 feet from the Windfall Road junction. The booking page sells it for RVs and trailers, while the DCNR campsite map layer marks it as having no trailer access. The agency cautions that it is reached by dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Stone fire ring; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 024 Red Ridge still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 40 ft, back-in dirt driveway 40 ft, grades Slight; count 1 and 40 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri and PASDA leaf-off): pin under closed conifer canopy about 20 m north of the forest road and about 40 m west of a second road; pad not resolved, pin not moved. NHD: Windfall Run 31 m from the pin (waterfront lead, not written).
flags: Ruling 5 applied: the booking page lists 'RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' with Max Vehicle Length 40, while the DCNR GIS record for 024 Red Ridge says 'TrailerAccess: No'. Kept, both statements in the note.

Waterfront lead (stored 'not waterfront'; not written): NHD puts Windfall Run 31 m from the pin and an unnamed tributary 42 m. The page makes no water claim. Both image sets show the pin under closed conifer canopy; neither the pad nor any open ground to the stream is visible. A creekside candidate that imagery cannot confirm, so it stays down.
The DCNR GIS record says 'Water: Non-Potable' for this site (every other site in the batch says None or is blank); the booking page lists no water. potable_water false written.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Surface: Dirt', 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 20'. No Severe grade, no 4WD or wet-weather statement, no closure. Kept. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).

ATV check (ruling 1): the site page(s) say nothing about ATVs and do not call the ground a parking area. The DCNR Susquehannock ATV Trail brochure names five trailheads (District Office, Sunken Branch, Route 44, Rock Run, Lyman); none is this site. The camp at the Rock Run trailhead is a separate site, '029 Rock Run ATV' in the DCNR GIS layer, not part of this entry. Kept.
NAME: the stored name carries the site's own name and road as the booking system gives them ('Site, Loop: 024 Red Ridge, Red Ridge Rd'); nothing to change.
Equestrian check: the Susquehannock camping page names the Dyer and Horsey Hilton equestrian areas; this entry is neither and its page(s) list no horse category.

Susquehannock advisories page (read 2026-11-10): district office closure Oct 17-18, 2026; Rausch Road reopened July 31, 2025; 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' (the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail uses some PennDOT, township and forest roads); a dust advisory. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice, and nothing on this entry's road. The camping page publishes no seasonal closure or site rotation.
